Item 1. Business

We design accelerated computing platforms. Our GPU products serve gaming, professional visualization and data center customers. Artificial intelligence workloads are an increasing part of demand. We also serve robotics and autonomous vehicle markets. Semiconductor supply is sourced from third party foundry partners.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business depends on demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure, which may not grow as expected. Export control regulations restrict sales of certain accelerated computing products to some regions. We depend on a limited number of foundry partners; capacity constraints could impair our ability to meet demand. Customer concentration is significant. Competition in semiconductors is intense.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition

Revenue grew on data center demand. Gross margin was stable. We continue to invest in our GPU roadmap.
